messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's current action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, following the movement demonstrated in the reference video. Retain the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's current action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, following the demonstration in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands in profile, then raises both hands to the head to adjust the hair, and finally lowers the arms and turns slightly forward.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium-full shot from the side, keeping the subject centered against the background.","clothing":"A light blue and white patterned cable-knit sweater, dark blue jeans, and brown lace-up boots.","hair_color":"Light brown or dark blonde.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a small topknot bun at the crown of the head.","identity":"A young adult with a slim build and light skin, shown in profile.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park or fairground at dusk, featuring a covered structure with a row of white lights, a red and white striped food cart, and a red vendor cart on a paved surface."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output person now lowers their head and raises a hand to the forehead/head area, then lowers the arm and turns slightly forward. The person's clothing, hairstyle, hair color, and overall identity remain consistent, and the amusement-park setting and static side camera are largely preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, following the reference motion, while retaining identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression, and leaving scene and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the hand position precisely matches the reference motion of resting on the forehead.
unexpected_changes: The hand appears to touch the side of the head or hair rather than clearly resting on the forehead in several frames.
The output includes a slight forward turn at the end, which is not clearly part of the requested pose.
